evidence_excerpts: 1. 200MP camera resolution is available in photo mode on the main wide sensor. Optical quality 2x and 10x zoom enabled by Adaptive Pixel sensor combining pixel binning and AI super resolution.
2. Galaxy AI features provided for free until end of 2025 on supported Samsung Galaxy devices. Samsung Account login and network connection required for cloud-based AI features.
3. Typical value tested under third-party laboratory conditions. Rated (minimum) capacity is 4,855mAh. Actual battery life varies by network environment, features, apps used, and call frequency.
4. IP68 rating based on lab test conditions for submersion in up to 1.5 meters of fresh water for up to 30 minutes. Not advised for beach or pool use.
